title: Important Studio Update: Systems & Payment Information
description:
Dear Karma Community,

First, a heartfelt thank you for your patience and grace with us lately. We know our recent booking and payment system hasn’t been the seamless experience you deserve, and we’re moving forward with a much better, more grounded solution.

Our goal is always to protect our independent space and care for this community. We’re preparing an improved system for September 1st. We will have more information in the coming days, but for now please take a look at the information below.

What this means for you:

 * Please keep showing up: If you run into tech hiccups, take a breath—it is not you! You’re doing nothing wrong, and our doors are wide open. Just come to class.

 * Booking: You can still find our schedule and reserve spots at karma.yoga and app.karma.yoga.

 * Memberships: Your memberships remain active and steady. If you need to make changes or cancel, email team@karma.yoga—give us about a week or two to process it with care.

 * Exceptions: Restorative Yoga & Reiki (Thursdays @ 7:30 pm) and Sunday Self-Care (Sundays @ 5:30 pm) still require online pre-registration. If it shows full, it really is full; if your plans change, please cancel so a neighbor might have the opportunity to join.

We are so grateful to be in this practice and transition alongside you. If you need anything at all, please reach out with questions to team@karma.yoga.

With gratitude,

Olivia + The Karma Yoga Team
